decisions.reason: Process data archiving and reporting software sits close to the firm's core offer and supports its move toward data-driven, web-based infrastructure management; it costs little to keep and still holds option value, and its parallel variant B has already been consolidated away.

Flow measurement automation software launched in 2019 is still a young, low-cost option tied to the firm's digital strategy, and its uncertainty has not yet resolved against it, so keeping it is worth more than the small carrying cost.
